source_v1_frozen_byte_identity.note: v2 reuses the exact v1 prompt and evidence-message bytes; these are the pinned hashes of the v1 originals the copies must equal

requested_settings_change.basis: the prior, separate pilot2 instrument obtained 95/96 parseable logical calls at an 11000-token allowance; operational precedent for a cap choice only - explicitly not a guarantee of success, not proof that the 2000 cap caused the v1 failure, and not semantic validation
requested_settings_change.reasoning_parameter: none: v1 requested no explicit reasoning parameter, so v2 requests none; 11000 is the maximum billed output per call including any provider reasoning tokens

transport_timeout.scope: transport-only socket timeout for the chat request; NOT a generation setting - the sole generation-settings change remains max_output_tokens 2000 -> 11000
transport_timeout.basis: pinned call-001 took 28 s for 2000 completion tokens and still ended finish_reason length; an 11000-token non-streaming response plausibly needs minutes of server silence, so the unchanged 30 s timeout would abort with no raw body and record a permanent unreconciled liability
transport_timeout.fail_closed: a timeout still raises a transport-error refusal, stops the stage before any further dispatch, and an unknown charge remains an unreconciled liability (never assumed to be zero)

design.sentinel_family: anonymous empty-dossier sentinels only (model x variant)
design.limitations: one draw per cell cannot estimate within-cell repeat variance; without neutral-label cells the design cannot test label invariance; nothing here validates country rankings. Feasibility diagnostics only.
design.sentinel_semantics: empty-dossier sentinels must return status 'insufficient_evidence' with score null; any other output stops the run fail-closed (context-aware semantic check); core cells keep the unchanged contract and may abstain or score; the broader independent semantic review is a separate, still-open process
design.semantic_checkpoint: one scheduled cell per invocation under the shared lock; before the next dispatch every earlier completed output needs an independent PASS review (runs/<run-id>/semantic-reviews/call-NNN.json) bound to response_sha256, the score-blind sidecar sha256, the frozen system-prompt and user-message hashes and the rubric version - every record/sidecar/review message and prompt binding cross-checked against the re-read immutable frozen schedule/message/prompt bytes for that call (never only against the writable attempt record) and each attempt chained to this invocation's receipt hash - with named reviewer identity/session; missing/FAIL/UNCERTAIN/tampered review, a failed prior attempt, or an unreconciled liability blocks all later calls before price/credential/network access; reviewers judge source fidelity against the frozen dossier without numerical values or rankings; this runner never writes a review or authors a verdict

plan.input_reservation_method: UTF-8 bytes of the frozen prompt + message plus a fixed 128-unit chat-framing allowance per call; administrative reservation units under stated assumptions - explicitly NOT a guaranteed provider tokenizer bound and NOT a provider-enforced spend limit

prior_accounting.source: reconstructed with Decimal directly from the four original probe-result.json files and v1 runs/country-feasibility-20261108-v1/attempts/call-001.json billed_on_failure
prior_accounting.rounded_summary_warning: v1's rounded summary fields (0.00108 + 0.000913 = 0.001993) are display values only; budgeting uses the exact decimal 0.001993276 and never a rounded total

historical_output_budgets.note: older and new output budgets are kept separately and never merged or rounded; the v2 budget is the exact integer 220000 tokens (20 x 11000)

evidence_snapshot.note: data-only, path-whitelist-derived evidence reused byte-identically through the frozen messages; no published scores, no sub-national (ADM1) values and no new evidence are inputs

budget_risks: the USD 10.00 guard is enforced locally between calls only; a single in-flight call is postpaid and can overshoot the local guard before the next check - there is no provider-side hard spend guarantee
unknown or inconsistent prices/usage, cache-WRITE billing that cannot be reconciled with the advertised prices, and any reservation breach stop the run fail-closed

the STRICT per-answer semantic checkpoint makes every later dispatch conditional on an independent PASS review of the previous answer - outcome-dependent stopping and partial outputs are disclosed limitations, not publication-grade evidence

cache_policy.request_cache_directives: none ever sent (no cache key in the request whitelist); no cache warming, busting, forcing or retries to obtain a preferred cache condition
cache_policy.provider_initiated_reads: allowed only when reported usage/cost arithmetic is valid (ints, totals consistent, cached_tokens <= prompt_tokens, finite cost within the reservation); full cache usage is logged in every attempt as an execution condition - with no claim of reproducibility or of uncached performance
cache_policy.cache_writes: any nonzero cache_write_tokens stops the stage: cache-WRITE billing cannot be reconciled with the advertised prices this runner fetches, so it is never assumed to be free
cache_policy.provenance: token counts alone do not identify cache provenance; provider cache state is uncontrolled and precludes latency/cost reproduction claims
